name: 10B — human-needs macro model
description: Top-level **10B** model — captures the human needs of every population on earth as a (257 countries × 15 categories) embedding, jointly trained on a supervised hold-out trajectory of sociodemographic characteristics and an unsupervised dynamics head that reveals attractors and transitions in the macro-space.

external_dependencies.install_hint: Download the FRB/US Python package from https://www.federalreserve.gov/econres/us-models-package.htm into <repo>/pyfrbus/ (data at <repo>/pyfrbus/data/), or set $BWM_FRBUS_PCIM. Not redistributed by 10B.
external_dependencies.name: FRB/US (Federal Reserve)
